review.reason: 리뷰 거절: server/internal/httpapi/handlers_analytics.go:136-137 The same-origin proxy (the default, analytics.momento_proxy=true) drops the collector's base path. `proxied.SetURL(target)` already joins target.Path with the request path, but the next line overwrites `Out.URL.Path` with `TrimPrefix(request.URL.Path, "/momento")`, so a collector stored as `http://momento.internal:8080/collect` — which validateSettingValue explicitly accepts (analytics_test.go:167) and which direct mode renders as `<momento_url>/tracker.js` (analytics.go:199, ADMIN_GUIDE.md `<momento_url>/tracker.js`) — is forwarded to `http://momento.internal:8080/tracker.js`. Verified with a throwaway test: collector at `<url>/collect` saw `/tracker.js`. Result: with a path-mounted collector the tracker 404s and no visitor is counted, silently; direct mode and proxy mode disagree on the same setting. TestTheProxyReachesTheCollectorWithoutTheBrowsersCredentials only uses `collector.URL + "/"`, so the case the validation admits is never exercised.

server/internal/httpapi/server.go:229 `/momento/` is an unauthenticated open relay (any method/path, 256 KB body) to the configured collector while the proxy is on. Intended by design (browser must reach it without credentials), and 404 on a fresh install, but it means anyone who can reach Ptium can reach the collector's whole path space through it.

server/internal/httpapi/server.go:229 The route is the subtree `/momento/`, so a request to exactly `/momento` (the value of data-endpoint) is answered with a 301 to `/momento/` by ServeMux; harmless if the Momento tracker appends a sub-path (the test posts to /momento/collect/v1/events), worth confirming against the tracker contract.

server/internal/httpapi/handlers_admin.go:206 trackingAfter().Validate() now runs on every settings save, including non-analytics sections; if the stored analytics values are ever invalid (e.g. seeded outside the API), unrelated saves are refused with an analytics error.
